Marimo Notebook

this notebook was created using Marimo's built into tool that coverts jupyter to marimo to show advantages and limitations of reactivity

What is x?

Marimo will not allow you to assign values to 'x' in 2 different cells. This breaks the reactivity. When this notebook was produced by Marimo's Jupyter converter tool, it renamed x to x_1 for the second instance of x. Notice the error when x is initialized in 2 different cells. No problem is x is assigned twice in the same cell.
